verdict.rationale: AWS offers Bedrock/AgentCore for building generative-AI agents on your own data (aws-docs-25, aws-docs-33, aws-docs-44) and Cost Explorer/Budgets for combining data into 'cost insights' dashboards (aws-docs-16, aws-docs-17), but these require developers to build and wire up the AI capability rather than AWS surfacing AI-generated insights natively inside its console/products for an end user. missing for 10: evidence of built-in, ready-to-use AI insight features (e.g., anomaly detection, recommendations) surfaced directly in AWS console products without custom development, and independent corroboration that such insights work well in practice.
